name: productops-prioritization
description: Rank a product backlog with RICE and WSJF, compare methods and test capacity scenarios. Works offline.
long_description: Local MCP server for product prioritization. The scores are computed by code, deterministically, and every number can be reproduced; the model only explains them. Includes a demo SaaS backlog and the roadmap-prioritization prompt, which turns the results into a recommendation: what to take, what to defer, and the trade-offs.

tools.name: calculate_rice
tools.description: Score and rank initiatives with RICE

tools.name: calculate_wsjf
tools.description: Score and rank initiatives with WSJF

tools.name: compare_initiatives
tools.description: Compare rankings across methods and show disagreements

tools.name: simulate_capacity
tools.description: Fit the backlog into team capacity, with what-if scenarios

tools.name: explain_ranking
tools.description: Explain why an initiative ranks where it does

tools.name: triumvirate_brief
tools.description: Optional: briefs for three independent judges (dev, business, product)

tools.name: triumvirate_verdict
tools.description: Optional: merge the three judges and surface their disagreements

data_dir.title: Backlog folder
data_dir.description: Folder with your backlog CSV or JSON files. The server reads nothing outside it. The demo backlog works without it.
